extraction.Name: William Grant
extraction.Refused/Protested: I said to the farmer "Suppose I don't accept this?" and he answered "Don't you want the land?" I said nothing more, and he asked me to sign a slip which I did without reading it.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Ed Surbey for a house and lot; sold to Clement Valandra, who got it for the Crookston State Bank, Crookston, Nebr.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: children were very sick with whooping cough and I had to take them out of school and could not take them home so had to get a house and lot in St. Francis
extraction.Fee Patent Date: 1920 (approximate; delivered at White River, mailed to allottee)
extraction.NOTES: Received $1,000.00 and two horses worth about $200 for the two, plus a second hand car and a note of $600.00 at 10% interest for six months; did not read the receipt slip before signing; signed receipt: Yes; did not make application for patent (No application)
